audit_items.proof_trace: The property requires all port-3000 handlers to pass `authMiddleware`, but `GET /health` (L38-65) is intentionally registered without it. This exposes the Discord guild ID, bot user tag, and WS connection status to unauthenticated callers, and triggers a live Discord API call (`client.guilds.fetch`) on every request. All `/api/*` routes (L68-77) correctly apply `authMiddleware`; the sole violation is the intentional health-check bypass.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated external attacker can call `GET /health` to enumerate the Discord guild ID and bot identity for reconnaissance, and can repeatedly invoke the endpoint to trigger Discord API calls against the bot's token, potentially exhausting its rate limit.
